🔥 The fire settles. Bauyrzhan has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Bulldozer — I put it down today." "Lowers its head, paws the earth. Dust rises. It is not going around the tree. It has never gone around anything." "It stops. Blood on its snout, sides heaving. It has decided you are not worth dying for — it backs away, quills flat." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Petra mutters "So it bleeds." Sanne breathes "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
